description: Long-context needle (~60k tokens, 234 KB, 2051 lines). One planted fact at ~70% depth with near-miss distractors (other room/cooler/old code). The file exceeds the per-call tool output cap (derived from n_ctx: budget/4, clamped to 4 KB-256 KB, e.g. ~62 KB at 128K tokens; 64 KB when n_ctx is unknown): a plain cat is truncated or BLOCKED and an unranged read_file returns only an outline/head/tail (or a sub-agent digest above 5x the cap), so the agent must read it in start_line/end_line chunks (each ranged read is cut to ~80% of the cap with a continue hint).

Write only the code, in the form d-d-d-d, to answer.txt and state it in your final answer.
